findings.title: Pairwise comparison of `ml` vs `true` is computed on unfiltered link files rather than the 51.0M analysis sample
findings.what_the_code_does: `pairs_true` and `pairs_ml` are saved at `MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:142-150` right after `keep if fiveyr_band == 1` and `duplicates drop histid1930 histid1940, force`, before the sample denominator merge (`merge m:1 histid using den_`s'', keep(3)` at line 159). Lines 233-241 merge `pairs_true` and `pairs_ml` directly to compute `mt_both`, `mt_trueonly`, and `mt_mlonly`, and line 250 writes those counts at the top of `MATCHING/results/tgt_linkage_abe.md` right above `## All records (N = 51,036,859)`.
findings.why_it_matters: The raw link files include 1940 records outside `linkage_sample1940.dta` (boys aged 8-9 and ~4.82M divided-file records not in `census1940_all_labeled_data.dta`), so `mt_both + mt_trueonly` (~13.49M) does not sum to the `Links` row for `New (paper)` (`12,555,546`) in the `All records` table immediately below it. Moreover, if `mt_trueonly` or `mt_mlonly` is nonzero, the unfiltered counts do not tell whether the difference occurs inside the `N_full = 51,036,859` sample scored in the tables or only among out-of-sample records.

findings.title: On `Non-target` and `All` records, `Share validated, MI (%)` evaluates `New` with `mi_ml` but `Target-only` with `mi_anc` on non-target records without noting the difference in the output header
findings.what_the_code_does: Lines 79-82 set `mi_v_ans = mi_anc`, `mi_v_true = mi_ml`, `mi_v_ml = mi_ml`, and `mi_v_mltgt = mi_tgt`. On `Target records` (`target == 1`), `mi_tgt` equals `mi_ml`, so `New (paper)`, `New (rerun)`, and `Target-only` are evaluated against the same 1940 middle initial. On `Non-target records` (`target == 0`), `mi_tgt` equals `mi_anc`, so `Target-only` is evaluated against Ancestry's 1940 middle initial whereas `New (paper)` and `New (rerun)` are evaluated against the model's 1940 middle initial (`mi_ml`).
findings.why_it_matters: Scoring each version against the 1940 middle initial its matcher used is intentional (`MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:20-24`), but in the `Non-target records` and `All records` panels of `MATCHING/results/tgt_linkage_abe.md`, differences in `Share validated, MI (%)` and `Links with both initials` between `New` (`true`/`ml`) and `Target-only` (`mltgt`) reflect both differences in the linked pairs and switching the 1940 validation initial on non-target records from `mi_ml` to `mi_anc`. Unlike `MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:170-171,188-189`, the markdown output header in `score_tgt_links.do:248-250` does not state this or provide a common-initial row.

findings.what_the_code_does: Lines 84-87 count target records with `mi_tgt != mi_ml` and non-target records with `mi_tgt != mi_anc` and print `r(N)` without `assert r(N) == 0`. Line 122 prints `truth pairs: _N (expected 36,690,338)` without `assert _N == 36690338`.
findings.why_it_matters: Because the main-table replication check at lines 202-227 only tests `N_s`, `nv_s_c`, `rate_s_c`, and `sv_s_c` for `ans` and `true` (none of which depend on `mi_tgt` or `mlp_training1930_1940.dta`), a mismatch in `mi_tgt` or a wrong version of `mlp_training1930_1940.dta` would only appear in console output while the script still exits 0 and writes `MATCHING/results/tgt_linkage_abe.md`.

summary: `MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do` faithfully implements the sample definitions, link filtering, two-sided truth classification (`Verified`, `Unverifiable`, `Contradicted`), recall, and middle-initial validation of `LINKAGE/code/01_abe_jw/linkage_analysis.do`, and enforces exact replication of the main table's `ans` and `true` numbers before writing output. Two minor issues merit attention: the pairwise `ml` vs `true` comparison (`mt_both`, `mt_trueonly`, `mt_mlonly`) is computed on the unfiltered link files rather than restricted to the 51,036,859-record analysis sample (`den_full`), and the markdown output does not note that `Share validated, MI (%)` on non-target records evaluates `New` (`true`/`ml`) against `mi_ml` while evaluating `Target-only` (`mltgt`) against `mi_anc`.
